dedupe_keys.name: godeeep tgw hydrology and hydropower modelling scripts

description: The GODEEEP research team archives scripts for a United States hydrology-to-hydropower modelling chain. The Zenodo snapshot points to the paper-revision1 GitHub tag, whose public tree includes forcing preparation, VIC calibration, MOSART routing and R scripts that create and validate hydropower outputs. The archive is free under CC BY 4.0; the licence applies to this archived release, while the current GitHub main branch has no declared licence. Coverage follows the contiguous United States power-system study represented by data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower. The code can help reproduce or adapt hydropower inputs for capacity-planning and climate simulations. A caveat is that several stages assume high-performance computing and separately sourced forcing and plant files. A README link for the hydropower folder does not resolve at this tag, although the scripts are present. No workflow was run. The later PNNL GitLab implementation is inaccessible and its version relationship was not verified.
